verification_script_source:
"""Step a: verify researcher decisions 1 and 2 for S15 manual review. Read-only."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
OUT = Path(sys.argv[2])
S15 = ROOT / "results/diagnostics/s15"


def load(p):
    return json.loads((ROOT / p).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256((ROOT / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def whole_word(term, text):
    # Same rule as tests/test_leakage.py::scan_surface.
    return [m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\w)" + re.escape(term) + r"(?!\w)", text, re.IGNORECASE)]


def substr_contexts(term, text):
    out = []
    for m in re.finditer(re.escape(term), text, re.IGNORECASE):
        s, e = m.start(), m.end()
        while s > 0 and re.match(r"\w", text[s - 1]):
            s -= 1
        while e < len(text) and re.match(r"\w", text[e]):
            e += 1
        out.append(text[s:e])
    return out


sheets = {}
for split in ("expansion", "pilot", "screening", "smoke"):
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in (ROOT / f"data/agent_inputs/{split}.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l.strip()]
    for r in rows:
        sheets[(split, r["query_id"])] = r

audit = load("results/diagnostics/s15/audit-v2.json")
overlap = load("results/diagnostics/s15/source_name_overlap.json")
captures = audit["S15_A"]["captures"]
systems = sorted({c["messages"][0]["content"] for c in captures})
problems = []

# ---- Decision 2: messages ----
if len(captures) != 24:
    problems.append(f"expected 24 captures, found {len(captures)}")
if len(systems) != 1:
    problems.append(f"expected exactly 1 distinct system prompt, found {len(systems)}")
system = systems[0]
msg_rows = []
for c in captures:
    roles = [m["role"] for m in c["messages"]]
    row = sheets.get((c["split"], c["query_id"]))
    if roles != ["system", "user"]:
        problems.append(f"{c['query_id']}: roles {roles}")
    if row is None:
        problems.append(f"{c['query_id']}: not in {c['split']}.jsonl")
        continue
    expected = row["question_text"] + "\n" + f"Starting entity: {row['start_name']} (PrimeKG ID: {row['start_id']})"
    ok = c["messages"][1]["content"] == expected
    if not ok:
        problems.append(f"{c['query_id']}: user message != exact pattern")
    msg_rows.append({"query_id": c["query_id"], "split": c["split"], "exact_pattern": ok,
                     "start_name": row["start_name"], "start_id": row["start_id"]})

numbers_in_system = re.findall(r"\d+", system)
standalone_numbers = sorted({n for n in re.findall(r"(?<![\w.])\d+(?![\w])(?!\.\s)", system)})
enumerators = re.findall(r"(?m)^(\d+)\.\s", system)

suffix_ids = ["BH2_03750", "BH2_03951", "BH2_04474"]
suffix = {}
for qid in suffix_ids:
    hits = [r for (s, q), r in sheets.items() if q == qid]
    cap = [m for m in msg_rows if m["query_id"] == qid]
    suffix[qid] = {"in_captures": bool(cap),
                   "start_name": hits[0]["start_name"] if hits else None,
                   "ends_with_disease_suffix": bool(hits) and hits[0]["start_name"].endswith(" (disease)")}
    if not suffix[qid]["ends_with_disease_suffix"] or not cap:
        problems.append(f"{qid}: suffix check {suffix[qid]}")

# ---- Decision 1: short names ----
short = overlap["short_names"]
if len(short) != 34:
    problems.append(f"expected 34 short-name entries, found {len(short)}")
qids = sorted({s["query_id"] for s in short})
if len(qids) != 26:
    problems.append(f"expected 26 queries, found {len(qids)}")
short_rows = []
for s in sorted(short, key=lambda x: (x["query_id"], x["name"])):
    row = sheets[(s["split"], s["query_id"])]
    line = f"Starting entity: {row['start_name']} (PrimeKG ID: {row['start_id']})"
    surfaces = {"starting_line": line, "system_prompt": system, "question": row["question_text"]}
    ww = {k: whole_word(s["name"], v) for k, v in surfaces.items()}
    sub = {k: substr_contexts(s["name"], v) for k, v in surfaces.items()}
    if any(ww.values()):
        problems.append(f"{s['query_id']} {s['name']}: whole-word hit {ww}")
    if s["present_in_starting_line"] or s["present_in_system"]:
        problems.append(f"{s['query_id']} {s['name']}: audit flags present=True")
    short_rows.append({"query_id": s["query_id"], "split": s["split"], "name": s["name"],
                       "start_name": row["start_name"], "start_id": row["start_id"],
                       "whole_word_hits": {k: len(v) for k, v in ww.items()},
                       "raw_substring_contexts": {k: v for k, v in sub.items() if v}})

substring_entries = [r for r in short_rows if r["raw_substring_contexts"]]

result = {
    "script": "verify_s15_review.py (scratchpad, read-only)",
    "rule": "case-insensitive whole word (?<!\\w)TERM(?!\\w), re.IGNORECASE, as tests/test_leakage.py::scan_surface; plus raw case-insensitive substring",
    "inputs_sha256": {p: sha(p) for p in [
        "results/diagnostics/s15/audit-v2.json",
        "results/diagnostics/s15/source_name_overlap.json",
        "data/agent_inputs/expansion.jsonl", "data/agent_inputs/pilot.jsonl",
        "data/agent_inputs/screening.jsonl", "data/agent_inputs/smoke.jsonl"]},
    "messages": {
        "captures": len(captures),
        "distinct_system_prompts": len(systems),
        "system_prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(system.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
        "user_messages_matching_exact_pattern": sum(m["exact_pattern"] for m in msg_rows),
        "digit_runs_in_system_prompt": numbers_in_system,
        "rule_list_enumerators": enumerators,
        "disease_suffix_queries": suffix,
        "per_capture": msg_rows,
    },
    "short_names": {
        "entries": len(short), "queries": len(qids),
        "whole_word_hits_total": sum(sum(r["whole_word_hits"].values()) for r in short_rows),
        "entries_with_raw_substring": [{"query_id": r["query_id"], "name": r["name"],
                                        "contexts": r["raw_substring_contexts"]} for r in substring_entries],
        "per_entry": short_rows,
    },
    "problems": problems,
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result["messages"].items() if k != "per_capture"}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
print("short-name entries:", len(short), "queries:", len(qids), "whole-word hits:", result["short_names"]["whole_word_hits_total"])
for r in substring_entries:
    print("  substring:", r["query_id"], r["name"], r["raw_substring_contexts"] if len(str(r["raw_substring_contexts"])) < 300 else {k: sorted(set(v)) for k, v in r["raw_substring_contexts"].items()})
print("PROBLEMS:", problems)
